decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The window formed in the northern flank elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern and southern flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No part of the roof of the single-storey rear extension shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 7 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Erection of a single storey side extension and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
